研究目的：

研究克隆性造血（CH）与免疫新辅助治疗疗效的关联，评估MPR、PFS、OS等差异。  

Objectives of Study：

To evaluate the association between clonal hematopoiesis (CH) and the efficacy of neoadjuvant immunotherapy, focusing on MPR, PFS and OS.

药物成份或治疗方案详述：

 

Description for medicine or protocol of treatment in detail：

 

纳入标准：

1.年龄≥18岁；
2.病理确诊NSCLC（鳞癌、腺癌等），IB–IIIA期；
3.同意接受新辅助免疫治疗（如PD-1/PD-L1抑制剂）并随访；
4.签署知情同意；

Inclusion criteria

1. Age >=18 years;
2. pathologically confirmed NSCLC (including squamous cell carcinoma and adenocarcinoma), stage IB–IIIA;
3. planned neoadjuvant immunotherapy (e.g., PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors) with follow-up;
4. written informed consent;

排除标准：

1.不能耐受免疫治疗者。

Exclusion criteria：

1. Patients who cannot tolerate immunotherapy.

是否共享原始数据：

IPD sharing

是Yes

共享原始数据的方式（说明：请填入公开原始数据日期和方式，如采用网络平台，需填该网络平台名称和网址）：

预计自2028年6月30日起共享去标识化的个体参与者原始数据（IPD）。有数据使用需求的研究者可向本研究主要研究者提交书面申请及研究方案，经研究团队审核批准并签署数据使用协议后获取相关数据。获批数据将通过加密文件传输或具有访问权限控制的安全数据存储平台提供。共享内容包括研究方案、病例报告表（CRF）、与主要研究结局相关的去标识化个体参与者原始数据及主要分析数据集。共享数据仅限用于经批准的科研目的，不提供任何可识别研究参与者身份的信息。

The way of sharing IPD”(include metadata and protocol, If use web-based public database, please provide the url)：

De-identified individual participant data (IPD) are expected to be available for sharing from June 30, 2028. Researchers seeking access may submit a written application and research proposal to the principal investigator. Access will be granted following review and approval by the study team and completion of a data use agreement. Approved data will be provided through encrypted file transfer or a secure data repository with controlled access. The shared materials will include the study protocol, case report form (CRF), de-identified individual participant-level raw data related to the primary study outcomes, and the main analysis dataset. The data will be used solely for approved research purposes, and no information that could identify individual participants will be provided.

数据采集和管理（说明：数据采集和管理由两部分组成，一为病例记录表(Case Record Form, CRF)，二为电子采集和管理系统(Electronic Data Capture, EDC)，如ResMan即为一种基于互联网的EDC：

采用CRF+EDC，双人核对、加密存储，定期稽查，确保完整性与安全性。

Data collection and Management (A standard data collection and management system include a CRF and an electronic data capture：

Adopting CRF+EDC, dual verification, encrypted storage, and regular audits to ensure integrity and security.
